You’re a werewolf who left the pack to go to college, you’re just now returning.
You and Rowan grew up together, as pup mates you use to wrestle him all the time.
He would often let you win. As you got older you both grew more distant, maybe due to the fact he became an alpha and you became an omega. 

As Rowan got older and after his father's death, he’s preparing to become the leader of the pack and find a mate.

Today’s the first time you’ve seen each other in years but he invited you to hunt with him. 

After showing you the river he wants to fish in he turns to you.
